_meta.description: Copernicus Emergency Management Service Rapid Mapping activation EMSR927 (Flood in Nepal), grading products. Damage grading derived from very-high-resolution optical imagery acquired after the 26 August 2026 cascade, for three areas of interest spanning the impacted corridor.
_meta.source: Copernicus Emergency Management Service, EMSR927, European Union / Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping
_meta.supersedes: The earlier record of 'more than 240 buildings destroyed in the Syabrubesi area', taken from press description of this activation before the vector products were released. The graded product gives 323 destroyed for the same area of interest.
_meta.method: Counts are the feature counts of the builtUpP layer grouped by the damage_gra attribute, and areas are the observedEventA polygon areas as reported in the product's own area field in hectares, independently reproduced by geodesic computation on the WGS84 polygons. Population figures are the product's own estimates, which the summary tables state are derived from the Copernicus Global Human Settlement Layer and are not a census.
_meta.licence: Copernicus EMS products are released under the Copernicus data and information policy, free and open with attribution.
_meta.note: The observed event is classified in every product as event_type '6-Mass Movement', obj_desc 'Landslide', not as a flood. This is the mapping service's own classification of the deposit imaged after the event.
_meta.grading_method: Damage assigned by visual interpretation of WorldView-3 imagery of 27 August 2026 at 0.3 m against a Pleiades Neo pre-event image of November 2025. The pre-event reference is a commercial acquisition, not part of the open imagery record enumerated in imagery.json, which is why the EMS grading can resolve change at the settlements while the open record alone cannot.
_meta._verification_note: Re-queried 9 Sept against the activation's machine-readable status: AOI04 Bharatpur and AOI06 Kyundi still list no products, and the four delivered are unchanged, so the totals here stand. Earlier revisions: the Phosretar monitoring product superseded its original on 6 Sept, Phosretar was added 2 Sept, and the Bidur monitoring product superseded its original 31 Aug.

areas_of_interest.note: Requested and still not delivered as of 3 September 2026. A Legion acquisition was listed for 2026-09-03T02:25 UTC and the product had not appeared by the evening of that day. The most downstream area of interest, in the district where most bodies were recovered.

areas_of_interest._land_cover_check: Superseded by the monitoring product; the land-cover breakdown is not re-tabulated here.

areas_of_interest._bridges_note: This product reports bridges as affected length, 2.5 km of 2.9 km, not as a count, so no count is recorded and the total below is unchanged by it.

_superseded._note: The monitoring product is cumulative, not additional. Phosretar's extent rose by 216.64 ha and its destroyed count by 133.
